// Witness for `every_utility_error_reaching_the_cli_is_armed`.
//
// `NeverArmedError` is named by no `downcast_arm!` anywhere under
// `crates/ocx_cli/src/`, so a scanner that still reads a `pub fn` signature
// reports exactly one reach here. A scanner that stopped reading signatures —
// or an armed set that grew to swallow everything — reports none, and the
// clean scan over `utility/` would then mean nothing.
//
// The commented signature below is the C-007 half: a reach written inside a
// comment must not count, so this file is only a witness because of the live
// one underneath it.
//
// pub fn commented_out_is_not_a_witness() -> Result<(), NeverArmedError> {}

pub fn crosses_the_boundary_unarmed() -> Result<(), NeverArmedError> {
    unimplemented!()
}
